edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender into owner, making the caller the privileged account.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source balance holder.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender.
burn uses msg.sender as the balance holder.
burnFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender.
whenTransferAllowed compares now with transferAllowTime, creating timestamp dependency on transfer.
saleIsOn compares now with mintFinishTime, creating timestamp dependency on batchMint.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts allowTransfer to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts batchMint to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts finishMinting to the owner.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction in transfer.
Subtraction result is written back into balances, risking underflow state corruption.
Addition result is written back into balances, risking overflow.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
TransferFrom subtraction result is written into balances.
Allowance subtraction result is written into the allowed mapping.
Mint amount array feeds the unchecked balance addition in the batchMint loop.
Mint addition result is written into balances for each recipient.
valueSum feeds the unchecked multiplication by restrictedPercent.
Multiplication result is assigned to restrictedSum.
restrictedPercent is used as the multiplier in the unchecked mint computation.
reserved amount restrictedSum is credited to the restricted address balance.
Computed totalSupplyNew is written into totalSupply after unchecked additions.
hardcap bounds the minted total, guarding against unbounded supply growth.
_value flows into the unchecked totalSupply subtraction in burn.
Burn subtraction result is written into totalSupply.
_value flows into the unchecked totalSupply subtraction in burnFrom.
BurnFrom subtraction result is written into totalSupply.
_spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve, forming the approve race-condition vector.
Approved _value is stored directly into the allowed mapping without zeroing the previous allowance.
newOwner replaces owner in transferOwnership.
canMint checks mintingFinished before allowing batchMint.
transferAllowed flag gates the transfer function via whenTransferAllowed.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.

_spender is a parameter of allowance used only for the lookup.
